population.eligibility.rationale: Putting both candidates back to the wording: the request says "list each musical style", not "each style that was chosen". The universe of “musical style” in this database is the Musical_Styles dictionary (25 rows, one per style); the 20 styles present in Musical_Preferences are only the observed subset, and semantic-guide S02 states "事实表中出现的对象不自动等于业务全集" — so the fact table cannot define the style universe. Candidate B therefore answers a narrower question and silently drops 5 styles. Candidate A keeps every style, and the count 0 for a never-chosen style is exact under the count definition, not an imputed zero. Probes differ (25 rows vs 20 rows, otherwise identical counts), so the choice is material; A is adopted as the literal reading. Alternative B and its row set are disclosed at delivery. compare_hypotheses could not be consulted (Jev HTTP 451), so this decision is made on the wording and the guide alone.
population.eligibility.value: include all styles in the Musical_Styles dictionary (styles never chosen appear with count 0)
